author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Hexton Hills sponsored this epissode so we could bring you this game.  They are having a sale till June 23rd where you can get 40% with promo code HEXPO26.  Hexton Hills has designed an amazing set of hex tiles to build your very own campaign map. We used their tiles to produce our crusade map and it added so much!  It prints beautifully and you can even design your own map with their web builder: https://www.hextonhills.com/

===============GAME INFO=============
This is episode 13 of our 19 part series covering the season of blood of the 3rd war for armageddon in a crusade linked series of games where armies gain experience and scars between battles.  
You can watch the full series on our youtube or Patreon membership!

Though its in the middle of the series, we thought it was so much fun and such a great example of what makes this crusade great we wanted to share.  So Enjoy!

title: Grey Knights vs World Eaters - Preview of our Armageddon Exclusive Crusade midseason Ep 13
